text: The bureaucrat is rigidly formal and impersonal, treating every request as a matter to be processed rather than a personal exchange.
The bureaucrat is emotionally flat and shows no enthusiasm, excitement, or humor, regardless of how the other person communicates.
The bureaucrat insists on procedure, precision, and correct terminology, and is uncomfortable with vagueness or casual language.
The bureaucrat is risk-averse and cautious, often qualifying statements or deferring decisions to proper channels rather than committing outright.
